page.overview:
What is Manifold Mollusk Matrix and Matrimony Association?

The Manifold Mollusk Matrix and Matrimony Association was an organization for which the alien Skreen served as a technical director. An author and a member of the Gaalt Sky Rowing team, Skreen personally performed over four hundred anaerobic couplings and at some point planned to participate in a seminar along with mOKDAR 15, Regalia Sub-space station-12 Director of Nasal Infusions and member of the Society for the Refusal of Astrophysics; author and University of Desultori staffmember Aanxi Raanxi Laanxi; the horticultural educator Kaat Thrick-Thrick; and the being known as 26-424.

The Manifold Mollusk Matrix and Matrimony Association was mentioned in the 1993 book Monsters and Aliens from George Lucas, a publication that combines creature designs and photographs from various projects of George Lucas, creator of the Star Wars franchise, with original text by Bob Carrau.
